findings: Teacher support validity is stored separately from GT validity.
One source-global permutation was fit on common-valid independent activity BCE only.
Raw sidecar probabilities are unclipped and not softmax-normalized.
Association used existing 1e-12 logit clipping and disclosed clip counts.
Permutation is a FIT task projection, not a human-identity guarantee.
Native model-load count is successful decoded trajectories only, not launch intent.
Class-conditioned 4x4 raw-native and mapped probability means are grouped by existing strict-solo GT labels on the common-valid mask inside each fixed quarter; absent classes are null, not zero.
Source-global min independent-activity-BCE permutation was not refit per quarter.
Original DUMP_DIR default exported incidental hidden and logits; those bytes are pinned and unused for learning. Future material must set EXPORT=logits.

execution_rules: Run the single execute command once. Sequential fresh native source-zero streaming process per exact FIT prefix; no whole-clip offline forward or optional hidden exports.
Use the reviewed effective environment and approved profile. Preserve all input/code/config/native hashes, durable intents, outputs and cost/failure receipts.
On any failure or uncertainty, stop and retain partials; no retry, source advance, scope adjustment, code/config repair or extra material execution without another Director decision.
No student forward/backward/optimizer run, no KD training, no CAL/DEV/locked target generation, no new corpus, no paid APIs, no installs or production changes.

Worker may retain only this run's outputs and its declared public result. Do not edit Director authority/release/adjudication records, shared GT/helper files or unrelated user work. No commit/push/merge/publication.
release.next_gate: Report actual supported rows/frontiers, source-global association diagnostics, resource/exposure ledger and readable limits. Director plus independent review decide KD eligibility; this release grants no further branch.
release.runtime: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -B on Windows, Torch CPU orchestrator, direct Windows native Vulkan child processes
